skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.backflip.desc: Standing on the ground, hold back (and nothing else) and press the dodge key (Left Alt) to throw a backflip instead of the back roll: a high hop backwards, heels over head, landing on your feet still facing the same way. It dodges blows the way a roll does and costs more feathers than one.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.205: In the air, the dodge key throws a trick if there's time to finish it before you land. Forward, back or a strafe key picks which kind.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.206: With the Backflip perk, hold back and press the dodge key to flip over backwards instead of rolling.
